title: Automated Logistics Manifest Digitization
business: Logistics and supply chain firms managing high volumes of paper-based shipping manifests.
problem: Manual data entry from scanned shipping documents is slow, error-prone, and creates bottlenecks in warehouse processing.
solution: GLM-5.3-Flash provides an image-text-to-text capability that allows the system to ingest scanned document images alongside text instructions to extract structured data directly into logistics databases.
steps: Configure the model environment to support image-text-to-text input processing.
Define the target schema for shipping manifest data extraction.
Submit the scanned manifest image with a prompt requesting structured JSON output.
Validate the extracted fields against the existing manifest database records.
outcome: Increased throughput of document processing and reduced reliance on manual verification for standard shipping manifests.
limitation: The model may struggle with low-resolution or heavily skewed images, which can be checked by monitoring the confidence scores of the extracted structured output fields.
